title: Kiss Boost
paragraphs: “I’ll ask again—many times, if I have to. You’re not a legitimate Seven Star Hero, are you? If the Seven Star Weapon had abandoned you, it would make sense that I was able to revoke it…”
“Motoyasu-san, is it possible to revoke a weapon for abandoning its mission?”
“In the previous loop, it didn’t work on Trash, so I don’t think it’s possible. He had practically abandoned his mission.”

I’m not sure how far the staff was devoted to Trash, but I don’t believe it could be revoked. If I recall correctly… in the original world, Father mentioned that the Four Holy Heroes rank higher, and they can revoke the qualifications of the chosen ones, but I wasn’t able to do it. Perhaps the command itself is different.
“When I think about Motoyasu-kun’s order, ‘Release the foolish restraint of power and awaken’… That phrase suggests that some kind of power was binding the Seven Star Weapon.”
Father glared at Cola and the others. It’s already certain they’re the same as Takt.
“Are our assumptions wrong? You were using some improper power to bind the Seven Star Weapon… just like the Whip Hero.”
“Most likely. Considering Takt’s precedent, we can assume this Yuta person possesses a similar level of power.”
“Bubuu!”
The pigs started squealing again. As always, I have no idea what they’re saying.

“Do you think you can do whatever you want just because you’re the Four Holy Heroes? I told you, didn’t I? The weapon that Yuta-kun was holding is a Projectile Weapon of the Seven Star Weapons, and it rightfully belongs to a Hero. But Yuta isn’t the rightful owner. That’s why we’re asking about it.”
“In this world, people like us are akin to the nation’s soldiers. We’re merely questioning whether you’re a criminal or not. That’s not oppression.”
“Rather, you might be the ones committing a crime here. Are you even aware of that?”
Father and the others responded with half-exasperated expressions. Negotiation seems impossible. If we’re going to get information out of them, it would be safer to tie them up tightly and…
persuade them. In other words, torture.
“Bububu, bubububu!”
“Bubububuhii!”
“Ugh…”
Cola’s face was starting to show signs of panic. The pigs were still standing by his side, refusing to lower their guard.
“Bububu!”
Just as they were about to lunge at us, Itsuki shot his gun and knocked the weapon out of their hands.
“I won’t tolerate any more of this misconduct.”
“You have no chance of winning. Surrender quietly. If you do, I won’t take your lives. So? What did you do to the Hero of the Projectile Weapon?”
Father is being merciful. With these people who are completely beyond redemption, killing them all would be the quickest solution.
“Bububu!”
Then, one of the pigs shouted something at Cola.
“Ah, got it! I’m going all out!”
“Are they really still going to fight?”
“I can’t understand why they’re being so stubborn.”
“…They probably know they’re committing a crime. Let’s not hold back anymore and just capture them.”
“Understood!”
Finally, I can go all out! Time to destroy them! Just as I was about to pour my strength into my spear, Cola pulled one of the pigs close and… kissed it.
“W-What…?”

An intense, nauseating, unspeakable kiss between a pig and a human unfolded before my eyes, leaving not just me, but even Father and the others, frozen in place. Cola was holding the pig tightly and kissing it deeply.
Ughhhhhhh… I feel like throwing up. To suppress this overwhelming nausea, I need to think of Filo-tan.
“Mmm… mmm… mmmmm…”
“Bu… Bububu…”
“W-What is he doing? Is he trying to fulfill his last wish before dying or something…?”
“Y-Yeah. We’re trying to capture them alive, but maybe they’re ready to die fighting.”
“Father, I’ll sing!”

I start singing a song that reminds me of the time Filo-tan encouraged me. If I don’t do something, I won’t be able to endure this disgusting scene. It’s fine when animals like the Pig King and a pig are mating, but a kiss between a human and a pig is nothing but revolting! And then, Cola went on to kiss each of the pigs one by one.
“Motoyasu-kun suddenly started singing!”
“Let’s just ignore it! More importantly…”
Itsuki’s face was turning a bit pale. What happened?
“Naofumi-san, does anything come to mind? You’re the most open otaku among us adults.”
“Eh? Uhh… well…”
Father, after being asked by Itsuki, turned his gaze toward Cola.
“A kiss… adults… game… No way!?”
Father seemed to have realized something as well. He really is knowledgeable.
“Mm…”
With a wet smack, Cola ended the kiss with the pig.
“Bububu!”
“Ah, now we can win!”
“Bubuu!”
Cola and the pigs each pulled out what looked like reserve weapons, and the pigs in the back began chanting magic.
“Ren, Motoyasu-kun! Be careful! These guys—”
Before Father could explain, Cola and the others had already started moving.
“Bububu!”
“Take this! Our power! Even if you’re heroes, can you keep up with this?”
With that, Cola and the pigs charged at us, moving about twice as fast as before.
“Bubububu!”
“H-How are they faster than before!?”
Ren was caught off guard and quickly assumed a defensive stance. Indeed, they were faster than before. But they were nowhere near Filo-tan’s speed.
“As expected… Kiss Boost!”
“Is that what it’s called in Naofumi’s world?”
Itsuki answered Father. However…
“It’s not a speed we can’t handle.”
I thrust my spear right into the pig’s chest. No matter how fast they are, if I catch them, it’s meaningless.
“B-Buhi—!?”
“R-Rinel!”
As I skewered the pig, Cola’s face twisted in disbelief. At this level, dodging my attacks is impossible.
“Itsuki, Father, what is this?”
“Motoyasu messed up again!”
“Motoyasu-kun!”
Huh? Father is calling me out. Understood!
“Burst Lance X!”
Boom! The pig exploded into pieces.
“R-Rinel—!”
Cola screamed something.
“Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
“Buuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu!”

As soon as they snapped out of their shock, they synchronized their movements with the remaining pigs and charged at me. They were definitely faster now. Judging by eye, they were moving about as fast as when Father first cast Zweite Aura. Even with their power-up, they were still far slower than Filo-tan back then.
“Meteor Spear!”
“Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
With my Meteor Spear, Cola and the pigs were blown away. Of course, I held back since Father mentioned that he had questions for Cola.
“Aaaaaah… Motoyasu-kun has massacred them again…”
“Hero-killing is said to be punished more harshly than death. Considering their comrades…”
“B-Buhi!”
“Good, they’re still alive.”
Father and the others sighed in relief. Hmph, the pig I hit with my Meteor Spear is still breathing. Stubborn pigs.
However…
“Bububububuhihihi bububu!”
“Bububububububuhiiiiiiii!”
With a loud thud, one of the pigs that had been providing support from the back cast a spell as if to finish off the one I had left alive.
